notes: Modified cash basis school district; governmental funds only (nutrition is within governmental funds, no enterprise funds). Net position = fund balances = cash: beginning 5,466,448 (p5), ending 5,424,089. Roll-forward: 5,466,448 + 9,552,231 - 9,594,590 = 5,424,089. Transfers in/out are blank in the total column of the statement (General (48,425) and Other Governmental 48,425 net to zero), so transfers_in/out are null at top level. Balance sheet taken from the Statement of Net Position (p3); no liabilities printed. 'Other receipts' 426,799 is split by the statement's own fund columns (p4): General 118,574 (mostly insurance adjustments, reimbursements/refunds, review), Special Building 1,409 (other, review), Other Governmental 306,816 (Activities Fund receipts, charges for services/fees). 'Student support services' 1,087,762 is split by fund column: General 706,080 support services, Other Governmental 381,682 (Activities Fund) student activities. The General column of the fund statement includes the Depreciation, Employee Benefit and other funds that have their own schedules. Detail: General Fund schedule functions reconcile to the statement only after including categorical/federal programs in instruction. The General Fund schedule total disbursements 8,464,292 embeds a 200,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (Depreciation Fund shows 200,000 Transfer from the General Fund; arithmetic: statement O&M of plant 732,748 = schedule 2610-2650 847,807 + capital outlay 84,941 - 200,000). Because the page does not show which O&M line holds it, lines 2610-2650 are kept as printed and the 200,000 is recorded as a -200,000 contra expenditure line on the O&M group plus a -200,000 other financing line, both with split_from and review. General Fund 'Transfers' receipt 1,575 (from Student Fee Fund) and 'Activities Fund support' 50,000 shown as other financing. Student Fee and Activities Fund schedules print no total expenditure line, so no expenditure total recorded. Lines with no 2025 actual (budget only) were omitted. Read pages 1-18 of 18
